summary.text: Eric Joss is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Carlos Barron and Democrat Dez Packard.
A technical writer, he was also on the ballot for this seat in 2022 and for Colorado State Senate District 13 in 2018.
